note: 关键词成句：给 5 个词，各写一句和雅思写作有关的句子，再对照模型句、固定搭配和常见错法。不判对错。

sets.d: 环境和城市话题的高频动词与名词

models: Many cities prohibit smoking in public places.
The law prohibits shops from giving out free plastic bags.
pit: 不能说 prohibit sb to do，必须是 from doing
名词是 prohibition，不是 prohibitment

models: We should reduce the amount of plastic we use.
The new tax is designed to reduce waste.
pit: reduce 后直接接名词，不加 down（reduce down 是错的）
reduce by 10% 是降幅，reduce to 10% 是降到

models: Food waste is a serious problem in rich countries.
A lot of money is wasted on packaging.
pit: waste 作「垃圾」时不可数，不说 a waste
a waste of + 名词 才是可数用法

models: Shops can reuse boxes instead of buying new ones.
Reusing bottles saves both money and energy.
pit: 前缀 re- 直接加在动词前，不加连字符
主语是动作时用动名词 Reusing…，谓语用单数

models: Factories pollute the river with chemicals.
The air is polluted by traffic.
pit: 名词 pollution 不可数，不说 a pollution
polluted 是形容词，the polluted river

sets.d: Task 1 里反复用的四个词

models: The proportion of young people rose sharply.
A high proportion of workers now use the internet.
pit: proportion 可数，常用 the proportion of + 名词
说「占 20%」用 account for 20%，不说 the proportion is 20%

models: There was a slight increase in 2005.
Sales increased by ten percent last year.
pit: 名词后面接 in，不是 of
by 接幅度，to 接最终数值

models: Sales peaked at 200 units in June.
Numbers reached a peak of 500 in 2010.
pit: peak at 后面接数值，不接 to
peak 作名词可数，用 a peak

models: The figure remained stable until 2010.
Country A remained the highest throughout.
pit: remain 是系动词，后面接形容词，不接副词（remain stably 错）
remain 没有进行时，不说 is remaining

models: The number declined steadily after 1990.
There was a sharp decline in sales.
pit: decline 作动词不及物，后面不直接接宾语
decline 作名词可数，用 a decline

models: Flexible hours help parents with young children.
Companies are offering more flexible working arrangements.
pit: 副词是 flexibly，修饰动词时才用
不说 flexible to do，用 free to do

models: She commutes to work by train.
A long commute leaves little time for family.
pit: commute 后面接 to + 地点
commute 作名词可数，用 a commute

models: Social media is a major distraction at work.
Working from home removes many distractions.
pit: 动词是 distract，distract sb from sth
distraction 可数，用 a distraction

models: People are often more productive at home.
The morning is my most productive time.
pit: 名词是 productivity
productive 后不接 of，不说 productive of work

models: It is hard to balance work and family.
Employees want a better work-life balance.
coll: strike a balance between A and B
pit: 两者之间用 between，三者以上才用 among
strike a balance 是固定搭配，不用 make

models: Schools should teach practical skills.
Students need practical experience, not just theory.
pit: practical 是「实用的」，practicable 是「可行的」，别混
practical 后接名词，不接 to do

models: Good teachers motivate students to read more.
Higher pay does not always motivate workers.
pit: motivate sb to do，不接 for doing
名词是 motivation，不可数

models: She graduated from university in 2020.
Many graduates cannot find a job.
pit: 考试里保守用 graduate from，不省略 from
graduate 作名词指人，毕业这件事是 graduation

models: Online courses give students more opportunities.
Everyone should have an opportunity to study.
pit: 可数，单数要加 an
opportunity to do，不用 for doing（for 后接名词）

models: Reading helps children develop their imagination.
Schools should help students develop social skills.
pit: develop 后直接接名词，不接 to do
兴趣用 develop an interest，不用 grow an interest

models: The city needs more affordable housing.
Public transport should be affordable for everyone.
pit: afford 是动词，用 can afford to do
affordable 前不加 more，比较级是 more affordable

models: Shops now charge five pence per bag.
There is a small charge for delivery.
pit: charge sb for sth，介词用 for
charge 作名词可数，用 a charge

models: It is difficult to enforce a ban on small shops.
The rules are not strictly enforced.
pit: 名词是 enforcement，不是 enforce
不说 enforce sb to do

models: Paper bags are not a good alternative.
We need to find alternative sources of energy.
pit: alternative to，不接 for
alternative 可数，用 an alternative

models: The company has a good reputation for service.
One bad product can damage a brand's reputation.
pit: 可数，用 a reputation
介词用 for，表示「因什么出名」
